note: Enrolled in v0.60.0. Guard-shaped since it was written and classified `candidate` by BL-101's registry, which is how it became countable. BL-121 was the blocker: 51 checks across these nine suites read a crashed probe as a pass, so a mutation registered here would have been registered against a check that could not fail. mutations.why: A file the guard has never been told about, carrying the prose the guard forbids. The editing form of a mutation cannot express this property: every edit lands in a file the list already names, so it proves the vocabulary scan and says nothing about the population that scan reads. That is precisely how this suite went on asserting `scanned == len(FILES)` — the length of its own tuple — while a shipped file sat outside it and a planted constant in that file passed (BL-211). Here the gap was not hypothetical: `renderers/render_operational.py` was on disk and outside the tuple, and this exact constant planted in it passed. The recomputation now reaches it, and reaching a file that did not exist when the proof was written is the stronger claim of the two.
defeats: no confidence vocabulary in the source of any shipped file
